checks.name: header-glass-layering-no-overlap
checks.evidence: site-header computed isolation === 'isolate'. For brand-logo-text and all 8 nav-link-* plus header-get-started-button, elementFromPoint at each control's screen center resolved to that exact data-testid (no decorative overlay intercepting). console_errors array from run was empty (no console/failed-request errors). Screenshot: header-glass-layering-no-overlap-header-full.png. Source confirms fix: index.css site-header::before uses z-index:-1 inside an isolate stacking context.
